flowchart TB
    subgraph SRC[Sources]
        D1[ChatDoctor]
        D2[PubMedQA]
        D3[MedMCQA]
    end

    subgraph PRE[Preprocess]
        FMT[Normalize]
        CLN[Clean text]
        CHK[Chunk 512t]
    end

    subgraph EMB[Embed]
        E[MiniLM-L6]
    end

    subgraph IDX[Index store]
        CH[(ChromaDB)]
        BM[(BM25 file)]
    end

    D1 --> FMT
    D2 --> FMT
    D3 --> FMT
    FMT --> CLN --> CHK
    CHK --> E --> CH
    CHK --> BM

    style SRC fill:#F4F6F7,stroke:#7f8c8d
    style PRE fill:#D5F5E3,stroke:#27AE60
    style EMB fill:#FCF3CF,stroke:#f39c12
    style IDX fill:#D6EAF8,stroke:#2980b9
